# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m154 engine update**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates the bundled rendering engine to Skia m154 while carrying forward the 4.153 release-line improvements. It includes Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, native packaging improvements, and fixes for resource lifetime and allocation overhead.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, so applications relying on the exact fontconfig fallback may see different glyphs or text metrics. Specify a family and style explicitly, or bundle the typeface, when font selection must be deterministic.

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestone m154** — Updates the bundled renderer through the m151 and m152 servicing syncs and m153 to Skia m154, bringing the current upstream engine to the release line. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — Adds managed bindings for the Graphite GPU backend on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface gain backend-neutral RequestReadPixels APIs for asynchronous pixel retrieval. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel and region sources remain alive during native use** — Fixes use-after-free failures when iterating SKRegion spans and when extracting or transforming SKPixmap subsets. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Native resources are released reliably** — Fixes raster-image allocation cleanup, HarfBuzz blob conversion cleanup, and replacement uniform-buffer disposal. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Reduced allocation overhead** — Improves common data saving, tag conversion, HarfBuzz shaping, runtime-effect uniform lookup, and handle registration paths. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))

## Platform

- **Improved native package coverage** — Restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package, produces Apple native symbol packages, and uses FreeType for Nano Server font support. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841), [#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp improves shaping and tag-conversion performance, fixes blob conversion cleanup, and carries the release-line packaging updates.
